title: mmc-sysid-benchmark: System identification benchmark for a grid-connected MMC (RTDS/RSCAD)
description: Code and data for a controlled simulation-based benchmark of classical, nonlinear/ML-based, and hybrid/physics-informed system identification methods applied to a high-fidelity grid-connected modular multilevel converter (MMC) model of the CIGRE B4.57 MMC-HVDC system simulated in RTDS/RSCAD. Accompanies the paper 'A Survey and Simulation-Based Benchmark of System Identification for Converter-Dominated Power Systems'.
notes: We gratefully acknowledge the support of the MITIGATE-HARM project (MITIGATE HARMonics in power electronics-based power systems), coordinated by TU Delft.
